status: planned; implemented and locally software-verified, no server execution evidenced
question: Are E124 response discrepancies dominated by neural integration clock, outer update clock, or different independently generated full-state phase anchors?
authorization: User Fine following proposed small fixed-weight numerical diagnostic; no fitting or model promotion.

peptide.role: Unchanged peptide-enabled parent, failed full-target convergence

method.phases: Four exact saved phases; deterministic, no new RNG or phase selection.
method.common_start: Identical saved E124 quarter-clock full neural and peptide state across all six clock settings.
method.own_start: Saved E124 coarse, half and quarter independently settled/phase-selected states at matching three joint clocks. No new settling.
method.fixed: Every weight, conductance, anatomical mask, passive/kinetic/release/calcium/indicator parameter and peptide coupling/gain/timescale; no trainable parameters. Load pinned explicit schema2 model. Original numerical modules unchanged.
method.outputs: Matched1ms voltage/calcium/indicator/peptide traces for RIVL,RMDVL,RMDR,RMDL; exact full-cell indicator means, all-cell outer-voltage min/max, final full states, all four phase responses. Means accumulated at every outer update before export downsampling.
method.comparisons: Neural-only versus coarse; outer-only versus coarse; successive joint refinements from common state; own versus common state at same clock. Original saved own-state response reproduction on available targets. Differences descriptive; no automatic causal attribution.

resources.outer_watchdog: 120min including kill grace; may finish earlier. Timeout/incomplete remains explicit.
resources.hardware: Two A100s, one pinned model per GPU, four distinct physical CPU cores per worker, float64; compact three-stimulus/two-sham batches.
resources.storage: Requires5GiB free. External compact traces/final states/full model copies, input/source hashes and exact source/env records; no result deletions.

acceptance.execution: All nine cases per arm finish, source/model hashes unchanged, saved metrics independently reproduced. Finite outputs and full final states, all-cell outer voltage bounds[-120,80]mV, duplicate-sham means<=1e-12 and traces<=1e-10. Repeat common/own quarter state at identical clock must reproduce response within1e-12.
acceptance.reproduction: Original own-state coarse/half three-target response maximum error<=1e-10; quarter comparison only for original training-panel overlap, missing overlap explicit.
acceptance.inference: No new numerical qualification gate. Preserve E124 failures. Common-state short replay is not independently settled full-domain convergence or a solver fix.

audit: Automatic even on partial execution: execution/budget, all model/state/input/source/artifact hashes, exact same checkpoint per case, starting-state hashes, response/sham arithmetic, finite/bounds checks, reproduction and clock/state comparisons. No selection/parameter update/behavior to qualify; all unavailable evidence explicit.
limits: Outer-only refinement changes all outer operations, not exclusively peptide memory.
No fresh60s settling or300s dynamics; only three stimuli and two models, not full-domain or all-fold acceptance.
Dense state traces for four cells only; no full channel-current attribution.
No optimizer or restart/reboot recovery, no behavior/start-stop/swimming or biological qualification.
local_validation: 35 focused CPU tests passed in float64, including independent toy-update oracle and source/model/state preparation. Shell syntax, Python compilation and diff checks pass. No Mac conductance/GPU forward run.
